skillFull: Shines a spotlight on the Cookie at given intervals. During the Spotlight Effect, Cookies can pass through obstacles, attract Jellies, and their Energy drains slower. Level Up for an even slower Energy drain during the Spotlight Effect.
story: Spotlight Fan brings out the very best in every Cookie, making it a joy to run. When it shines above you, a warm vanilla fragrance fills the air around you. If all this attention is just too much to handle, step out from under the glowing spotlight.

costumes.name: Auditorium Star
costumes.info: Even in a tiny school auditorium, all it takes is Spotlight Fan to rival a rock festival stage! No matter where it is, it can shine like a grand concert hall!
